blurb: Douglas County Trail Riders is a 501(c)3 non-profit horse club established in 1954, located near Lawrence, Kansas. They offer a wide range of activities including trail rides, horse shows, cowboy challenge courses, clinics, parades, fundraisers, community service, and social events. Visitors are welcome to attend events and meetings before becoming members.
extraNote: Membership fees are due by April 1st each year · Clubhouse and arena at 816 N. 1750 Road, two miles west and two miles north of Lawrence, KS
